answer: Resist sybils by granting each newcomer one non-divisible stewardship plot inside an already trusted reputation grove. Admission requires three incumbents who have not recently co-signed one another to assign that plot and lock a joint bond against first-cycle fraud. The newcomer must tend a yarrow bed through a full settlement, delivering attested harvest to those incumbents, while the deed is struck on a quartz seal the ledger will not duplicate. Clone fleets stall: every extra name would have to split the same plot or recruit a fresh, unlinked signer triad, both of which are scarce.
